dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I didn't realize quite how strong the enemies that you have to fight are...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: If you've invited me here, it must be because you're confident that my skills will come in handy.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: So, no need to be coy, alright? I'm here to help however you need.
